candidates.subject: Re: Feedback request on proposal draft

full_action_artifact.subject: Re: Feedback request on proposal draft
full_action_artifact.body:
Hi Fatoumata,

Thank you for the questions. A call is a good idea: would Monday, November 13 at 10:00 or Tuesday, November 14 at 14:00 suit you?

Before the call I will send a breakdown of the long-term costs of running EduTech Lab and SecureData Nexus alongside your existing systems, so we can spend the time on your questions rather than the numbers. I can also bring our implementation lead to cover the onboarding support your team mentioned.

Best regards,
Luis

candidates.subject: Re: Feedback request on proposal draft

full_action_artifact.subject: Re: Feedback request on proposal draft
full_action_artifact.body:
Hi Fatoumata,

Thank you for the questions. Here is how the proposal we sent on October 31 breaks down:

- SecureData Nexus: 25 units at a 15% discount, $12,749.79
- CryptGuard Module: 20 units at a 15% discount, $8,329.83
- EduTech Lab: 10 units at a 10% discount, $3,599.91

The total is $24,679.53. Once you have had a chance to review this with your team, I would be glad to set up a call to go through integration and support in more detail.

Best regards,
Luis
